name: The University of Kansas
notes: Scope: both domestic freshman GPA-only tables. Award academic year is not labeled on the source and is left unknown. No transfer or international-specific table drafted. NPC identifies a historical cycle; no COA inferred.
review_issues: Establish the award academic year from an official source.
General reuse terms were not located on the inspected admissions page; owner review needed.

research.policy_note: Bounded manual public-page review. Robots does not disallow this scholarship path. Only public facts and paraphrases retained; no logos, screenshots or copied page prose. General terms, where not located, remain an owner review item.

tiers.gpa_basis_note: KU uses weighted or unweighted GPA on a 4.0 scale, whichever benefits the student most, after sixth high-school semester. Weighted-transcript conditions apply. No rounding to tenths.
tiers.renewal_conditions: Maintain a 3.0 KU GPA and full-time enrollment; first bachelor's degree or eight continuous semesters, whichever comes first.
tiers.requires_action: Complete the admission application and transcript submission by December 1. Domestic students must enroll full-time immediately following high school. Exclusively online programs excluded.
